ANNUAL REPORT ISSUED UNDER SECTION 13 OF THE FISCAL MANAGEMENT(RESPONSIBILITY) ACT, No. 3 OF 2003
Annual Report of Ministry of Finance - 2016

FINAL Budget Position Report - Annual Report of Ministry of Finance - 2016 prepared in accordance with Section 13 ofthe Fiscal Management (Responsibility) Act, No. 3 of 2003, is available for inspections, free of charge at the office ofthe Superintendent, Government Publication Bureau, No. 163, Kirulapona Mawatha, Polhengoda, Colombo 05 duringnormal working hours. Copies of this report are also available for sale at the said office in Sinhala, Tamil and Englishlanguages, at Rs. 500/- per copy. This report is also available on the web site www.treasury.gov.lk
R. H. S. SAMARATUNGA,Secretary,Ministry of Finance and Mass Media.
Ministry of Finance and Mass Media,Colombo 01,13th June 2017.
